summary: Fixed the one open finding (REV-2). Inside a workspace the existing editor error banner was never rendered, so opening a workspace-owned file that cannot be read (too large, not found, unreadable) showed the person nothing: a failed open sets only the controller-level editor.error and adds no tab, and only the global views rendered it. src/App.tsx now renders editor.error as a role=alert banner with the existing wording and a Dismiss control in the workspace branch, just below the git bar and above the tab strip, so it is visible whether a terminal or an editor tab is selected; src/App.module.css gained .error/.error button styles matching the global view's. No other behaviour changed. src/App.editor.test.tsx gained one REV-2/R1 test: inside the Qonsol workspace a rejected open of a 'too large' file shows the too-large message, keeps the workspace on screen, creates no editor tab, and Dismiss clears it.
